My Story
The Journey

From a small town dreamer to walking the halls of IIT Delhi as a Campus Ambassador — my journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. Every step was self-made, every skill earned through determination.

Currently pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science (Sem 2) at Mewar University, Rajasthan, with an additional specialization in Data Science. The road wasn't easy — but like Karna, I chose to fight regardless.

I started with zero — no guidance, no roadmap. Just curiosity, YouTube, and an unbreakable will. Today I build ML models, design dashboards, create content, and mentor others through my channel Study Sujit.

2024 — Joined Mewar University, began Data Science journey

2025 — Internship at StaxTech | Mastered Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL

2025 — Campus Ambassador: IIT Delhi, IIT Patna, PW

2026 — Built Smart Home Assistant (ESP8266), ML projects, Sales Dashboard

Apr 2026 — Earned Tutedude Data Science Certificate 🎓
